name: [🎃 NEW OBSTACLE!🎃] Mount Atin
desc:
🌄 Mount Atin – Conquer the Summit
Embark on the ultimate hiking adventure up Mount Atin, a towering peak that rises to an incredible 4,000 meters above sea level (mdpl). Your journey begins at the foothills, where you’ll trek through lush forests, climb dangerous cliffs, and brave narrow ledges that push your courage and endurance to the limit. As you ascend, the route becomes steeper, the air thinner, and the challenge greater. Only the most determined hikers will reach the Puncak, where the reward is a breathtaking panoramic view from the top of the world.

✨ Features

⛰️ A full route from basecamp to 4,000 mdpl
🌿 Scenic biomes: forests, ridges, and rocky cliffs
🌤️ Dynamic weather and atmospheric effects
🎯 True summit experience with panoramic views
👥 Team up with friends or test yourself solo

Do you have what it takes to conquer Mount Atin and stand tall at its peak?
